First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before the start time. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: social and steady. It's no-drop: if you fall off the back, someone waits. That's the point of a group ride.
Check
Look at @rar.philadelphia the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the RAR Philadelphia Group Rides group ride

The Philadelphia chapter of Radical Adventure Riders centers FTWN-B and BIPOC riders. Rides in 2026 have included gravel on Forbidden Drive, a donut loop on MLK Drive and a More Miles series for going longer. No fixed weekly slot; follow Instagram or the Strava club.
